summary: ansible-core supports Windows PowerShell 5.1 and, from 2.21, the latest PowerShell 7.x LTS; every fifth release supports both the outgoing and incoming LTS. A table maps core 2.21 to 2.25 to PowerShell 7.6 and 7.8 LTS, with 2.28 the next overlap release.
questions: Does Ansible support PowerShell 7 on Windows hosts?
Which PowerShell version does ansible-core 2.22 support?
Which ansible-core release supports both PowerShell 7.6 and 7.8?
When does PowerShell 7.6 LTS reach end of life?

answer_card.title: PowerShell support on Windows targets
answer_card.answer_md:
- Windows PowerShell **5.1** (built into Windows) is supported.
- From ansible-core **2.21**, the latest **PowerShell 7.x LTS** is also supported.
- Every 5th release overlaps two LTS versions to ease migration.

| ansible-core | PowerShell | Lifecycle |
|---|---|---|
| 2.21, 2.22, 2.23 | 7.6 LTS | Mar 2026 - Nov 2028 |
| 2.24 | 7.6 and 7.8 LTS | 7.8: Nov 2027 - Nov 2029 |
| 2.25 | 7.8 LTS | Nov 2027 - Nov 2029 |

The next overlap release is 2.28 (PowerShell 7.8 and 7.10).
